metadata.name: St. John's
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A look-alike of the St. John's Northwestern Military Academy campus in Delafield, Wisconsin, on Lake Nagawicka: grey lannonstone halls built like castles, with towers, turrets and battlements, set in a U round the drill field and its flagpole. Fight through the barracks of DeKoven, Hazelwood and Scott Johnston, the long tables of the Welles refectory under its clock tower, the classrooms of the Knight block and the pews of the Victory Memorial Chapel. Take the sniper rifle from DeKoven's roof, the railgun from upstairs in Smythe, rockets from the chapel and the damage boost from the Gerber pool. The west team holds the drill field and Hazelwood; the east team the gym, the old red church and the lakefront across Genesee Street.
